I created `/workspace/repo/packages/sheets-ui/src/views/defined-name/defined-name.utils.ts` with the four functions, each matching the specified behavior:

**`validateDefinedName(deps)`** → `string | null | undefined`
- Returns `'definedName.nameDuplicate'` when `definedNamesService.getValueByName(unitId, name)` is non-null (and also for table-name conflicts), `'definedName.nameSheetConflict'` for sheet-name conflicts, `'definedName.nameConflict'` for function-name conflicts, `'definedName.nameEmpty'` for empty, and `null` when valid.

**`resolveDefinedNameBoxAction(deps)`** → one of the four action objects
- `focusDefinedName` when `getValueByName` matches (case-insensitivity is handled inside the service via `toLowerCase`),
- `focusSelection` with `refString: inputValue` when `isReferenceStringWithEffectiveColumn(inputValue)` is true (e.g. `'B2:C4'`),
- `createDefinedName` when `validateDefinedName` returns null (no conflicts),
- `reset` otherwise (e.g. sheet-name conflict).

**`getAbsoluteRefStringFromSelection(workbook, selections, refStringService)`**
- Builds `'SheetName!A1'` for a single cell or `'SheetName!B2:C4'` for a range using `Tools.chatAtABC` + 1-based rows, then returns `convertRefersToAbsolute(refString, AbsoluteRefType.ALL, AbsoluteRefType.ALL, sheetName)`.

**`restoreSheetNavigationAfterDefinedNameConfirm(deps)`** → always `true`
- Always calls `input.blur()`. When the cell editor is visible, closes it via `SetCellEditVisibleOperation.id` with `{ visible: false, eventType: DeviceInputEventType.Keyboard, keycode: KeyCode.ENTER, unitId }`. When not visible, calls `editorService.blur(true)`, `focusUnit(unitId)`, `getEditor()?.focus()`, and sets the five context flags to `false`.

Key facts I verified from the codebase: `getValueByName` is internally case-insensitive; the context constants and `AbsoluteRefType`/`Tools` come from `@univerjs/core`, `DeviceInputEventType` from `@univerjs/engine-render`, `KeyCode` from `@univerjs/ui`, and `IEditorBridgeServiceVisibleParam` uses the `keycode` field. No existing files were modified, and no test files were touched.
